scanNote:
12-UNITNING OLTINChI (OXIRGI) BETI (87-bet) - YoZUV.

Yuqorida o'ngda KO'K-YaShIL yorliqda oq '12', chapida 'Holidays with a Difference'.

CHAP USTUN:
• Katta to'q sariq 'Writing (an article describing holiday accommodation)'.
   TO'Q SARIQ RAMKA: 'When we write an article describing holiday accommodation (e.g. a hotel, a campsite etc.) we can divide it into FOUR paragraphs. In the FIRST PARAGRAPH, we write the NAME and LOCATION of the place and why it is SPECIAL. In the SECOND PARAGRAPH, we describe the place (e.g. restaurant, rooms, bars, etc.) In the THIRD PARAGRAPH, we write what people can do there (e.g. have a meal, have a drink, go skiing, go rafting, go fishing, etc.) In the LAST PARAGRAPH, we RECOMMEND the place and say when is the BEST TIME TO GO. We normally use PRESENT tenses in this type of writing.'
21) 'Look at the advertisement for the Golden Beach Campsite and answer the questions. Then, use the information in the advertisement to talk about the campsite.'
   REKLAMA (yashil-oq ramka, surat: chodir oldida er-xotin va qora it): qizil sarlavha 'THE GOLDEN BEACH CAMPSITE - SEA, SUN & LOTS OF FUN!'
   • 5 miles from Brighton • clean, attractive campsite • 100s of caravans to rent • 100s of tent sites available • caravans - for up to 6 people, modern kitchen, shower, toilet, TV, electricity, hot & cold running water • heated bathrooms on the campsite
   'NEVER A DULL MOMENT!' • heated outdoor swimming pool • games room - play pool/darts/table tennis • excellent children's play area • Golden Beach Restaurant (breakfast/lunch/dinner) • Dunes Bar
   'LOCAL OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES' • hiking, horse riding, cycling
   'THE IDEAL PLACE FOR A MEMORABLE FAMILY HOLIDAY!' 'Open from the beginning of May to the end of September. Please book in advance. Ask campsite staff for current prices. Tel.: (0273) 350729'

O'NG USTUN:
   TO'Q SARIQ RAMKA 'Questions': 1 What is the name of the campsite? 2 Where is it located? 3 Why is it special? 4 What can you find at the campsite? 5 What can you do at the campsite? 6 What outdoor activities are available locally? 7 When can you stay at the campsite? 8 What words are used to recommend the campsite?
22) 'Use the information from the leaflet in Ex. 21, and the plan below, to write an article about the Golden Beach Campsite (120 - 180 words). You can use the text in Ex. 4 as a model.'
   SPIRAL DAFTAR 'Plan': Introduction - Para 1: name and location of the place, why it is special. Main Body - Para 2: description; Para 3: what you can do there. Conclusion - Para 4: recommendation, best time to go.
• Katta to'q sariq 'Words of Wisdom': 'Read these sentences. What do they mean?' Ramkada: • 'Go abroad and you'll hear news of home.' • 'The more you get, the more you want.' • 'The best things in life are free.'

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '87'.

exercises.instructionEn: When we write an article describing holiday accommodation (e.g. a hotel, a campsite etc.) we can divide it into four paragraphs.
exercises.instructionUz: Ta'til turar joyini (masalan, mehmonxona, lager va h.k.) tasvirlovchi maqola yozganda uni to'rt xatboshiga bo'lishimiz mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLA TUZILIShI (4 XATBOShI):

  1 - NOMI, JOYLAShUVI, NEGA
      ALOHIDA
  2 - TAVSIF (restoran, xonalar,
      barlar)
  3 - NIMA QILISh MUMKIN (ovqat,
      ichimlik, chang'i, rafting,
      baliq)
  4 - TAVSIYa + ENG YaXShI VAQT

  ⚠ ZAMON: hozirgi zamonlar.


⚠ 'ACCOMMODATION':

  = turar joy (mehmonxona, lager).
  ⚠ SANALMAYDIGAN.
  ⚠ Ikki 'c', ikki 'm'!


⚠ 'A CAMPSITE':

  = lager, chodir maydoni.
  ⚠ 'camp' + 'site'.


⚠ 'E.G.':

  = masalan (lotincha 'exempli
  gratia').


⚠ 'TO RECOMMEND':

  = tavsiya qilmoq.

points.en: In the first paragraph, we write the name and location of the place and why it is special.
points.uz: Birinchi xatboshida joyning nomi, joylashuvi va nega alohida ekanini yozamiz.

points.en: In the second paragraph, we describe the place (e.g. restaurant, rooms, bars, etc.)
points.uz: Ikkinchi xatboshida joyni tasvirlaymiz (masalan, restoran, xonalar, barlar va h.k.)

points.en: In the third paragraph, we write what people can do there (e.g. have a meal, have a drink, go skiing, go rafting, go fishing, etc.)
points.uz: Uchinchi xatboshida odamlar u yerda nima qila olishini yozamiz (masalan, ovqatlanish, ichimlik ichish, chang'i, rafting, baliq ovlash va h.k.)

points.en: In the last paragraph, we recommend the place and say when is the best time to go. We normally use present tenses in this type of writing.
points.uz: Oxirgi xatboshida joyni tavsiya qilamiz va borish uchun eng yaxshi vaqtni aytamiz. Bunday yozuvda odatda hozirgi zamonlarni ishlatamiz.

exercises.instructionEn: The Golden Beach Campsite - Sea, Sun & Lots of Fun!
exercises.instructionUz: Golden Beach lageri - Dengiz, quyosh va ko'p qiziqarli narsalar!
exercises.explanationUz:
REKLAMA TARJIMASI:

  • Brightondan 5 mil
  • toza, jozibali lager
  • yuzlab ijaraga karavanlar
  • yuzlab chodir joylari mavjud
  • karavanlar - 6 kishigacha,
    zamonaviy oshxona, dush, hojatxona,
    TV, elektr, issiq va sovuq
    oqar suv
  • lagerda isitiladigan hammomlar

  HECh QAChON ZERIKARLI LAHZA YO'Q!
  • isitiladigan ochiq basseyn
  • o'yin xonasi - bilyard/darts/
    stol tennisi
  • ajoyib bolalar o'yin maydoni
  • Golden Beach restorani
    (nonushta/tushlik/kechki ovqat)
  • Dunes bari

  MAHALLIY OChIQ HAVO MAShG'ULOTLARI
  • piyoda sayohat, otda yurish,
    velosiped

  ESDA QOLARLI OILAVIY TA'TIL UChUN
  IDEAL JOY!
  May boshidan sentyabr oxirigacha
  ochiq. Iltimos, oldindan bron
  qiling. Joriy narxlar uchun lager
  xodimlaridan so'rang.


⚠ 'A CARAVAN':

  = karavan (g'ildirakli uy).


⚠ 'TO RENT':

  = ijaraga olmoq.


⚠ 'AVAILABLE':

  = mavjud, bo'sh.


⚠ 'UP TO 6 PEOPLE':

  = 6 kishigacha.


⚠ 'RUNNING WATER':

  = oqar suv (vodoprovod).


⚠ 'HEATED':

  = isitiladigan.


⚠ 'DULL':

  = zerikarli.
  'never a dull moment' = hech
  qachon zerikmaysiz.


⚠ 'POOL' (o'yin):

  = bilyard (basseyn emas!).
  ⚠ 'play pool' = bilyard o'ynamoq.


⚠ 'DARTS':

  = darts (nayzacha otish).


⚠ 'A DUNE':

  = qum tepasi.


⚠ 'MEMORABLE':

  = esda qolarli.


⚠ 'IN ADVANCE':

  = oldindan.


⚠ 'A MILE':

  = mil (1,6 km).

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the advertisement for the Golden Beach Campsite and answer the questions. Then, use the information in the advertisement to talk about the campsite.
exercises.instructionUz: Golden Beach lageri reklamasiga qarang va savollarga javob bering. Keyin reklamadagi ma'lumotdan lager haqida gapirish uchun foydalaning.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ Javoblar reklamadan.


⚠ 'AN ADVERTISEMENT':

  = reklama. /ədˈvɜːtɪsmənt/.
  ⚠ Qisqasi 'advert' yoki 'ad'.


⚠ 'LOCALLY':

  = mahalliy, yaqin atrofda.

items.en: 1 What is the name of the campsite?

items.answerEn: It is located 5 miles from Brighton.
It is a clean, attractive campsite with sea, sun and lots of fun, and there's never a dull moment.
items.answerUz: U dengiz, quyosh va ko'p qiziqarli narsalarga ega toza, jozibali lager, va u yerda hech qachon zerikarli lahza yo'q.

items.en: 4 What can you find at the campsite?
items.answerEn: Hundreds of caravans to rent and tent sites, heated bathrooms, a heated outdoor swimming pool, a games room, a children's play area, the Golden Beach Restaurant and the Dunes Bar.

items.answerEn: You can swim in the heated pool, play pool, darts and table tennis in the games room, eat at the restaurant and have a drink at the bar.
items.answerUz: Isitiladigan basseynda suzish, o'yin xonasida bilyard, darts va stol tennisi o'ynash, restoranda ovqatlanish va barda ichimlik ichish mumkin.

items.en: 6 What outdoor activities are available locally?

items.answerUz: Piyoda sayohat, otda yurish va velosiped.

items.en: 7 When can you stay at the campsite?
items.answerEn: From the beginning of May to the end of September.

items.en: 8 What words are used to recommend the campsite?
items.uz: 8 Lagerni tavsiya qilish uchun qanday so'zlar ishlatilgan?
items.answerEn: 'The ideal place for a memorable family holiday!' and 'Never a dull moment!'
items.answerUz: 'Esda qolarli oilaviy ta'til uchun ideal joy!' va 'Hech qachon zerikarli lahza yo'q!'

structure.modelEn: The Golden Beach Campsite is set just five miles from Brighton, on the south coast of England. It is a clean, attractive campsite which offers sea, sun and lots of fun for the whole family.
structure.modelUz: Golden Beach lageri Angliyaning janubiy qirg'og'ida, Brightondan bor-yo'g'i besh mil masofada joylashgan. Bu butun oila uchun dengiz, quyosh va ko'p qiziqarli narsalar taklif qiluvchi toza, jozibali lager.

structure.modelEn: There are hundreds of caravans to rent and hundreds of tent sites. The caravans are for up to six people and have a modern kitchen, a shower, a toilet, a TV, electricity and hot and cold running water. There are also heated bathrooms on the campsite, a heated outdoor swimming pool, a games room, an excellent children's play area, the Golden Beach Restaurant and the Dunes Bar.

You can swim in the pool, play pool, darts or table tennis in the games room, have a meal at the restaurant or relax with a drink at the bar. If you like outdoor activities, you can go hiking, horse riding or cycling in the local area.

Basseynda suzish, o'yin xonasida bilyard, darts yoki stol tennisi o'ynash, restoranda ovqatlanish yoki barda ichimlik bilan dam olish mumkin. The caravans are for up to six people and have a modern kitchen, a shower, a toilet, a TV, electricity and hot and cold running water. There are also heated bathrooms on the campsite, a heated outdoor swimming pool, a games room, an excellent children's play area, the Golden Beach Restaurant and the Dunes Bar.

There is never a dull moment at the Golden Beach Campsite. You can swim in the pool, play pool, darts or table tennis in the games room, have a meal at the restaurant or relax with a drink at the bar. If you like outdoor activities, you can go hiking, horse riding or cycling in the local area.

exercises.instructionEn: Read these sentences. What do they mean?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni o'qing. Ular nimani anglatadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
1) 'Go abroad and you'll hear
   news of home.'
   = Chet elga bor - uy haqida
   yangilik eshitasan.
   MA'NOSI: uzoqda bo'lganda o'z
   yurtingni boshqacha, yaxshiroq
   tushunasan.

2) 'The more you get, the more you
   want.'
   = Qancha ko'p olsang, shuncha
   ko'p xohlaysan.
   MA'NOSI: ochko'zlik - odam hech
   qachon qanoat qilmaydi.
   ⚠ QOLIP: 'The more ..., the
   more ...' = qancha ..., shuncha.

3) 'The best things in life are
   free.'
   = Hayotdagi eng yaxshi narsalar
   bepul.
   MA'NOSI: sevgi, do'stlik,
   tabiat - pulga sotib olinmaydi.


⚠ 'ABROAD':

  = chet elda, chet elga.
  ⚠ 'go abroad' - 'to' YO'Q!


⚠ 'FREE':

  = bepul (yoki ozod).

items.en: Go abroad and you'll hear news of home.
items.uz: Chet elga bor - uy haqida yangilik eshitasan.
items.answerEn: When you are far away from home, you learn and understand things about your own country that you didn't notice before.
items.answerUz: Uydan uzoqda bo'lganingizda o'z mamlakatingiz haqida oldin payqamagan narsalarni o'rganasiz va tushunasiz.

items.en: The more you get, the more you want.
items.uz: Qancha ko'p olsang, shuncha ko'p xohlaysan.
items.answerEn: People are never satisfied - when they have something, they want even more.
items.answerUz: Odamlar hech qachon qanoat qilmaydi - biror narsaga ega bo'lganda yanada ko'proq xohlaydi.

items.en: The best things in life are free.
items.answerEn: The most important things, like love, friendship, health and nature, cannot be bought with money.
items.answerUz: Sevgi, do'stlik, sog'liq va tabiat kabi eng muhim narsalarni pulga sotib olib bo'lmaydi.
